annotation.bound_parties_text: A person testing an automated driving system that cannot comply with all laws needs approval; state agencies and political subdivisions may not set different standards for automated driving systems; the Colorado Department of Transportation must report annually.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A STATE AGENCY OR A POLITICAL SUBDIVISION OF THE STATE SHALL NOT ADOPT OR ENFORCE A POLICY, RULE, OR ORDINANCE THAT SETS STANDARDS FOR. AN AUTOMATED DRIVING SYSTEM
annotation.dates_quote: This act takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day following the expiration of the ninety-day period after final adjournment of the general assembly (August 9, 2017, if adjournment sine die is on May 10, 2017)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: CONCERNING AUTHORIZATION FOR AUTOMATED DRIVING SYSTEMS TO CONTROL MOTOR VEHICLES THROUGHOUT COLORADO.
